variant_desc: pkDecode (rho, UnpackT1) + sigDecode (c~, z with ||z|| bound, strict hint encoding) with CIRCL's unpack routines.
Only sigDecode; the pkDecode result is cached per public key (as circl's PublicKey object does).
pkDecode + sigDecode where the ||z||inf < gamma1-beta check is fused into the z bit-unpacking loop (single pass, early exit) instead of a second pass.
tr = SHAKE256(pk, 64); mu = SHAKE256(tr || 0 || len(ctx) || ctx || M, 64) with CIRCL's internal sha3.
tr cached per public key (circl PublicKey caches it); only mu is hashed.
tr and mu with the Go standard library crypto/sha3 SHAKE256 (amd64 assembly Keccak) instead of CIRCL's pure-Go Keccak.
SHAKE256 state with tr || 0 || len(ctx) || ctx pre-absorbed per (pk, ctx); per message the state is cloned and only M is absorbed.
CIRCL Mat.Derive: 4 SHAKE128 streams at a time with the AVX2 4-way Keccak-f1600 (runtime detected).
Same binary, one SHAKE128 stream at a time (CIRCL's non-x4 fallback forced): isolates the 4-way Keccak gain.
K rows derived concurrently on goroutines (one per row), each row using the x4 sampler.
A^ cached per public key (what circl's PublicKey.Unpack stores); the stage degenerates to reusing the cached matrix.
NTT(z), A^ o NTT(z) (PolyDotHat), NTT(t1*2^d), SampleInBall(c~), NTT(c), MulHat, Sub, InvNTT, normalise: CIRCL's Verify body (AVX2 NTT).
NTT(t1*2^d) precomputed per public key; saves K forward NTTs per verification.
The K independent rows (dot product, c*t1 term, subtraction, InvNTT) on goroutines; NTT(z) and NTT(c) computed once.
||z|| check, VecK.UseHint (vector Decompose + hint correction), PackW1, SHAKE256(mu || w1Encode) and compare, CIRCL's code.
UseHint evaluated per coefficient with the scalar decompose and packed straight into the w1Encode buffer (no intermediate decomposed/w1 vectors).
The challenge hash c~' with the standard library crypto/sha3 (assembly Keccak).
End-to-end verify from the v0 stages (pkDecode+sigDecode, tr/mu, ExpandA, w_approx, hint check); same work as circl UnmarshalBinary + Verify.
End-to-end verify from the fastest correct alternatives: cached pkDecode/tr/A^/NTT(t1*2^d) per key, mu midstate per (key, ctx), fused z decode (decode.v2), fused UseHint+pack (hint_check.v1).
